developmentSteps.description: Use simple mock-ups and a full-size form model to assess the proposed task before committing to tooling or custom electronics.

developmentSteps.title: Evaluate feasibility
developmentSteps.description: Review real components or mechanisms, power where applicable, usability, structure and market-specific safety requirements.

developmentSteps.title: Decide whether to develop
developmentSteps.description: Agree scope, ownership, budget, prototype stages and validation responsibilities. Tooling and production assessment would be later decisions.

closingHeading: Would this direction fit your product range?
closingDescription: Share your target market, intended users and changes. Begin with a concept review and a development brief.

faqs.question: Does it recognise spoken answers?
faqs.answer: No speech recognition is proposed. Players choose from three physical buttons and a stored answer table.

faqs.question: Why is there no electronic screen?
faqs.answer: The initial direction focuses on listening and shared turns. Whether that makes questions easier to use must be tested with mock-ups.

faqs.question: How many questions are included?
faqs.answer: No final commercial content pack exists. The internal concept uses a small seed-library scenario; actual content and languages would be agreed during development.

faqs.question: Is this concept ready to order?
faqs.answer: No. It is an original digital concept for review. Feasibility, physical prototypes, tooling, electronics and validation would need a separately agreed development project.

faqs.question: Can it be adapted for our brand or market?
faqs.answer: Content, languages, appearance, audience and intended changes can be discussed. Feasibility, ownership, project scope, cost and market-specific safety work would need agreement.

faqs.question: What are the price, MOQ and lead time?
faqs.answer: They have not been set. A meaningful quotation requires an agreed specification, prototype scope, feasibility review and supplier assessment.
